scope: Prepare source-identical OLD/sham and one-expression GROUPED full-module WRF builds; after independent plan review and root GO, validate sham before grouped C/D six-hour runs.

baseline.qualification: Library member identity and historical frozen preprocessed-source association verified; no independent original compilation transcript has been established. Prior log files predate the archived files and must not be treated as current build commands.

ten_link_input_freeze.scope_note: The ten entries are explicit file argv inputs only, not complete link closure. Four -L/-l files and exact dynamic loader closure are separately listed below.

compiler.template_caveat: Prior CP03 strict-profile module compile/relink succeeded; its target was module_mp_kdm6, not module_big_step_utilities_em. Original full-host compile transcript and exact baseline compiler flags are unavailable. Compile both sham and grouped from the frozen full module source with identical recorded flags and include directories, then prove sham against baseline before attributing grouped.
compiler.ifx_and_setvars_audit: Must run from clean shell after sourcing this exact profile script; record actual resolved paths, hashes, versions, environment snapshot for each compile and link.

build_design.compile_scope: Compile full module_big_step_utilities_em.f90 twice from scratch using same pinned IFX executable, flags, ABI, private five-module .mod copies and byte-frozen other inputs. OLD_SHAM uses frozen original source bytes; GROUPED uses exactly one derived line replacement.
build_design.relink_scope: For each variant replace only module_big_step_utilities_em.o in a private copied libwrflib.a; link against ten explicit copied objects/archives plus four copied -L/-l archives. Hash every link input before/after.
build_design.scratch_policy: Lustre scratch only. Copy target source, demanded .mod files, all ten explicit inputs and four implicit -l archives. Link only private copies. Original /var/tmp host is read-only. No generated .o/.mod/archive/executable under Cloud-BAL source.
build_design.baseline_gate: After source-rebuilt sham, run limited test first, then run full six-hour OLD_SHAM for B1 and DM065 in parallel with C/D if matched original history is not fully reproducible from limited gates; compare all seven hourly histories byte-for-byte and input manifests. If sham differs, preserve evidence and stop attribution; diagnose full-module other-function differences or isolate target routine before grouped runs.
build_design.actual_operation_gate: For each rebuilt executable re-discover calc_p_rho_phi symbol and instruction addresses from that executable; do not reuse PR149 frozen PCs. Record disassembly/breakpoint hits and operand/result bridges for both expressions.
build_design.forecast_gate: After reviewer/root GO plus sham and actual-operation gates, run C (B1/GROUPED) and D (DM065/GROUPED) as two six-hour actual runs. If sham old outputs require materialization for comparator, run B1/DM065 OLD_SHAM as additional controls. Eight ranks each, disjoint verified CPU sets.
build_design.builder_guard: Builder refuses any input root other than the owned frozen Lustre input path and any build output outside runtime/native_build/variants or inside Cloud-BAL source; refuses pre-existing output dirs.

first_sham_failure.root_cause: Missing transitive module_configure dependency module_driver_constants.mod from the five-file direct USE set; IFX reported #7002 then cascading type errors. No link or model launch.

build_design.retry_policy: Use fresh OLD_SHAM_RETRY2 output; retain the original failed OLD_SHAM output and all earlier input-copy attempts without overwrite.

compile_module_dependencies.source: Static USE scan of frozen full module_big_step_utilities_em.f90 found five direct modules; IFX failure established that `module_configure.mod` requires transitive `module_driver_constants.mod`. To avoid one-at-a-time misses, freeze all .mod files in the exact original compile -I directory order and use the first occurrence for duplicate basenames.
compile_module_dependencies.module_copy_policy: Copy all selected unique .mod files into private scratch modules/ at mode 0444; duplicate basename winner is first original -I search directory. Builder passes only this private module directory; no compiler read from archived host module paths.

implicit_link_libraries.meaning: These four files occur in prior link argv only through -L/-l and are omitted from the 10 explicit file-argument hash map; they are part of link closure and must also be copied/hash-verified.
implicit_link_libraries.link_map_policy: Relink only against these copied archives via private -L dirs and ten copied explicit files; record exact final link argv and hash every input before/after.
